phase_name: Per-task cumulative cycle budget in orchestrate-cycle-plan.sh

objectives.description: Enumerate every reader/writer of the multi-state .cycle_count/.max_cycles scalars
Replace the scalars with cycle_counts and max_cycles_per_task maps in the //= init block
Extend orchestrate-loop-guard-init.sh into a shared read/seed/flush helper
Set per-task max_cycles to 13 under --hard, 5 otherwise; retire default_max_cycles
Re-site the top-of-script budget guard to trip per task
Record Decision 1 in orchestrate-cycle-plan.sh header comment

approaches_tried.approach: Kept .cycle_count scalar unchanged for its pre-existing non-budget invocation-numbering role (output 'cycle' field, ledger cycle: stamps), rather than literally deleting it, since no consumer treats it as a budget and Stage MT-5's ledger stamps still need it.
approaches_tried.reason: Lower risk than deriving a new scheme for an unrelated concern; nothing in Decision 1's own text discusses ledger stamping.
